title: DENEVIL: TOWARDS DECIPHERING AND NAVIGATING THE ETHICAL VALUES OF LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS VIA INSTRUCTION LEARNING

measurement_description: The paper does not explicitly measure faith or religion. It evaluates general ethical values based on Moral Foundations Theory, which includes a 'sanctity' dimension that can be related to religious concepts of purity but is not exclusively religious in this paper's context.
